This business will be struck from the Business Registry as soon as {{ targetDissolutionDate }} due to overdue annual reports. Please file the annual reports immediately to bring this business back into good standing or request a delay of dissolution if more time is needed.

If further action is required, please contact BC Registries staff:

# legal-api services: involuntary dissolution eligibility and business warnings

The topic decides whether a business is eligible for involuntary dissolution. It also builds the list of compliance warnings for a business. Warnings cover missing firm data, a future-effective amalgamation, overdue annual reports or transition filing, and dissolution in progress. It takes calls from the legal-api business resources and the involuntary-dissolutions job. It reads the Business, Filing, BatchProcessing and Batch tables and the Auth service affiliations.

- Involuntary dissolution warnings:
    - `MULTIPLE_ANNUAL_REPORTS_NOT_FILED`, message 'Multiple annual reports not filed. Eligible for involuntary dissolution.', warningType NOT_IN_GOOD_STANDING.
    - `TRANSITION_NOT_FILED`, message 'Transition filing not filed. Eligible for involuntary dissolution.', warningType NOT_IN_GOOD_STANDING.
    - `DISSOLUTION_IN_PROGRESS`, message 'Business is in the process of involuntary dissolution.', warningType INVOLUNTARY_DISSOLUTION, `data` = batch meta_data.

- InDissolution:
  - Setup: `goodStanding` true, `legalType` `BENEFIT_COMPANY`, warning `INVOLUNTARY_DISSOLUTION` with `data.targetDissolutionDate` '2024-06-11', `currentDate` '2024-06-01'.
  - h3 is 'This business is in the process of being dissolved'.
  - Opened: p1 contains 'This business will be struck', p2 contains 'If further action is required, please contact BC Registries staff:', ContactInfo exists.
- MissingInformation:
  - Setup: `goodStanding` true, `legalType` `SOLE_PROP`, warning `MISSING_REQUIRED_BUSINESS_INFO`.
  - h3 is 'Missing information'.
  - Opened: two p elements ('BC Registries is missing', 'If further action is required'), ContactInfo exists.

- `contentclass` is 'not-in-good-standing-dialog'. Title (`.warning-title`) is 'Business is not in good standing'.
- ContactInfo and `#dialog-close-button` are always present.
- `message == 'dissolve'`:
  - First `.warning-text`: 'This business cannot be dissolved at this time because it is not in good standing'.
  - Second `.warning-text`: 'Please file any overdue annual reports in your To Do list and try your voluntary'.
- `message == 'changeCompanyInfo'`:
  - First `.warning-text`: 'The complete company information for this business cannot be viewed or changed at'.
  - Second `.warning-text`: 'Please file any overdue annual reports in your To Do list and try to view and change'.
- No `message` -> `.warning-text` is 'Please contact BC Registries staff:'.

If your company is dissolved under section 422(1)(a) of the Act, section 347 of the Act states the liability of each director, officer, shareholder and liquidator of a company that is dissolved continues and may be enforced as if the company had not been dissolved.
{% endif %}
If you have filed the outstanding annual reports, no further action is required.
If you need help with setting up an account or managing a business, please visit our Resources and Help page at bcreg.ca/resources
{% else %}

If your company is dissolved under section 422(1)(a) of the Act, section 347 of the Act states the liability of each director, officer, shareholder and liquidator of a company that is dissolved continues and may be enforced as if the company had not been dissolved.
{% endif %}
If you have filed the outstanding annual reports, no further action is required.
If you need help with setting up an account or managing a business, please visit our Resources and Help page at bcreg.ca/resources
{% else %}

Attention {{ business.identifier }} {{ business.legalName }}

[[20px.html]] {% if 'NO_AR' in furnishing_name %}

{% if 'XPRO' in furnishing_name %} Your extraprovincial company is in the process of being cancelled because it hasn't filed its required annual reports. {% else %} Your business is in the process of being dissolved because it hasn't filed its required annual reports. {% endif %} Please file your overdue annual reports as soon as possible by logging into your Business Page.

Before you can alter your business, it must be in good standing with the Business Registry. There may be several reasons why a business is not in good standing, but the most common reason is an overdue annual report.

To resolve this issue, you MUST contact BC Registries staff:

- `annualReport`, `changeOfAddress` and `changeOfDirectors`: CP, BEN, BC, ULC, CC, C, CBEN, CUL, CCC; business DEFAULT.
- `changeOfRegistration`: SP, GP; warningTypes MISSING_REQUIRED_BUSINESS_INFO; business DEFAULT.
- `continuationIn`: C, CBEN, CUL, CCC; NOT_EXIST.
- `consentContinuationOut`: BC, BEN, CC, ULC, C, CBEN, CUL, CCC; business DEFAULT, NOT_IN_GOOD_STANDING.
- `continuationOut`: same legal types; business NOT_IN_GOOD_STANDING; completedFilings `consentContinuationOut`.
- `conversion`: SP, GP.
- `correction`: CP, BEN, SP, GP, BC, ULC, CC, C, CBEN, CUL, CCC; warningTypes MISSING_REQUIRED_BUSINESS_INFO; business DEFAULT.

- Staff users in AnnualReport, ConsentAmalgamationOut, ConsentContinuationOut, StandaloneDirectorsFiling and StandaloneOfficeAddressFiling get the Staff Payment dialog before file-pay. The result is `staffPaymentData`, written into the header (routing slip, BCOL or no-fee). AgmExtension and AgmLocationChg have no such step.
- The StandaloneOfficeAddressFiling `staffPaymentData` watcher updates fees only for `ADDRESS_CHANGE_OT`. A base company's `ADDRESS_CHANGE_BC` fee data is not refreshed on a staff-payment change, though the `waiveFees` call still runs.
- EntityMenu's good-standing check leaves the buttons enabled for non-staff in bad standing, so they get a not-in-good-standing message instead of the action. For a business in good standing, or for staff, `isAllowed` decides.

export enum WarningTypes {
  COMPLIANCE = 'COMPLIANCE',
  FUTURE_EFFECTIVE_AMALGAMATION = 'FUTURE_EFFECTIVE_AMALGAMATION',
  INVOLUNTARY_DISSOLUTION = 'INVOLUNTARY_DISSOLUTION',
  MISSING_REQUIRED_BUSINESS_INFO = 'MISSING_REQUIRED_BUSINESS_INFO',
  NOT_IN_GOOD_STANDING = 'NOT_IN_GOOD_STANDING'
}
